intent: Teach simultaneous goose hissing, egg-laying evidence, dry-grass transport, circling high over a valley, owl/parrot recognition with text-only sound clues, penguin entry and resting beneath a tree.
picturePurpose: Original owl/parrot recognition, three reversible material/route/direction diagrams and three exact evidence selections. Hearing times and imitation are text clues, not image or audio claims.

workshop.title: 读懂鸟的动作、声音与方向

transfer.stem: 草的状态、时间和进出方向换了，哪组英文全保留？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
鸟把湿草带到自己的巢里。天黑前，我们听见猫头鹰在叫。企鹅利落地从水里滑出来。
词语提示：wet 湿的；before dark 天黑前；out of 从……里面出来。

options.text: The bird carried dry grass to its nest. We heard an owl calling before dark. The penguin slipped neatly out of the water.
The bird carried wet grass to its nest. We heard an owl calling before dark. The penguin slipped neatly out of the water.
The bird carried wet grass to its nest. We heard an owl calling after dark. The penguin slipped neatly out of the water.
The bird carried wet grass to its nest. We heard an owl calling before dark. The penguin slipped neatly into the water.

answer.display: The bird carried wet grass to its nest. We heard an owl calling before dark. The penguin slipped neatly out of the water.

explanation.strategy: 按新信息分别检查材料、时间和方向，不沿用上一题的原句。

steps.reason: wet湿替换dry干；to its nest仍表示送到巢里。

steps.text: 从水里出来：out of the water。
steps.reason: out of是由里向外，不是into由外进入。

explanation.pitfall: 三条新条件都要保留，不能凭旧句熟悉程度选答案。

visual.title: 三条新条件
visual.caption: 材料、时间和方向分开核对；不补鸟种、时刻、水深或后续动作。
